text.body: <1> atha prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ kāntaṃ śāntamaśeṣajīvahṛdayānandasvarūpaṃ paraṃ sarvātmānamanantamādyamamalaṃ viśvāśrayaṃ kevalam | bhaktyānandarasaikavigrahavaraṃ bhaktaikabhaktipriyaṃ bhaktāveśadharaṃ vibhuṃ kamapi taṃ gauraṃ sadopāsmahe ||1|| kāmāgnimāyāśaśibaddhamūrtir nāmāmṛtābdhirviharansvaśaktyā | nāmaikagamyorasasāramūrtir nāmātmako nāmavinodakārī ||2|| bhaktīśayorabhedena kṛṣṇacaitanya ucyate | bhedātkṛṣṇasya bhakteśca prasiddhistattvavedinām ||3|| nāmacintāmaṇiḥ khyāto nāmarūpī janārdanaḥ | sa eva kṛṣṇacaitanyastasya nāmātmako manuḥ ||4|| atrārimitracintāpi na kāryā rāśibhedataḥ | sarvātmā sarvabandhuśca sarvamitraṃ jagatpatiḥ ||5|| sarve'dhikāriṇastatra pūjācaryājapādiṣu ||6|| manavo bahuśastasya dharmakāmārthamokṣadāḥ | satāṃ bhāgavatībhaktipradāḥ premapradāḥ kvacita||7|| bhaktiprakāśaṃ vidhivaccandrajyotsneva candrikā | kartrī cennāmato bhakticandrikā kathyate budhaiḥ | tadarthaṃ mantracaryāṇāṃ vidhānaṃ kathyate kramāta||8|| tatrādāvuddharenmantrāṃstataścaryāvidhiṃ kramāta| tenaiva yo japenmantraṃ labhate siddhimuttamām ||9|| mantroddhāramahaṃ vakṣye sarvakāmārthasiddhaye | kāmo dharitrīmāyendukalitaḥ syādratipriyaḥ ||10|| ajo vahniramāyuktaścandrakhaṇḍayutaḥ paraḥ | premākhyo nāma bījo'yaṃ premabhaktipradāyakaḥ ||11|| kṛṣṇacaitanya ṅervahijāyānto manuruttamaḥ | japādasyaiva mantrasya sarvasiddhiṃ vrajennaraḥ ||12|| rāmaiṃ hrīṃ kamalābījaṃ pratyekena niyojayeta| kāmasthāne nṛsiṃhaṃ ca vedādiṣaḍvidho manuḥ | ekena sādhayetsarvaṃ premabhaktiṃ viśeṣataḥ ||13|| eṣāmekatamaṃ mantraṃ yo japetsa mahāmuniḥ | stutyate sarvadevaiśca sa ca bhāgavatottamaḥ ||14|| atha caryāvidhiṃ vakṣye sarvamantrārthasādhanam | siddho na jāyate mantro vinā yena japādibhiḥ ||15|| brāhme muhūrte utthāya sādhakaḥ sthirabuddhimāna| bhālāmbuje guruṃ śuddhaṃ gauravarṇaṃ smitānanam ||16|| śuklamālyāmbaradharaṃ śubhracandanaśobhitam | svastikāsanasaṃviṣṭaṃ vyākhyāmudrākarāmbujam ||17|| dhyātvaiva tatpadāmbhojarajobhirvapurātmanaḥ | saṃśodhya hṛdideveśaṃ saṃcintya tatpadāmbuje ||18|| yathāśakti japenmantramātmānaṃ tanmayaṃ punaḥ | bhāvayanprātarutthāya snānārthaṃ ca jalāśayam | gatvā snātvā jalekṛtvā caturasraṃ ca maṇḍalam ||19|| tatraivāhayenmantrī tīrthāni manunādhunā | gaṅge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati ||20|| narmade sindhu kāveri jale'sminsaṃnidhiṃ kuru | ityanenāṅkuśenaiva mudrayā sūryamaṇḍalāta||21|| tatrāṣṭadhā japanmantraṃ śirasyañjalimaṣṭadhā | dattvā tatra tridhāplutya kṛtvā sandhyādikaṃ sudhīḥ ||22|| kāmaṃ premākhyamuccārya kṛṣṇacaitanyamādarāta| tarpayāmīti mantreṇa pañcaviṃśatimañjalīna||23|| dattvā nirvartya vidhivatsnānaṃ sādhakasattamaḥ | pūjāgṛhadvāradeśe śucirbhūtvopaviśya ca | saṃpūjya dvārapālāṃśca dehalīṃ laṅghayeta||24|| tataḥ— āsanastho'pi bhūtānāṃ śāntikarma samācareta| utpatantīha bhūtā ye pṛthivyambaravāsinaḥ ||25|| pṛthvi tvayā dhṛtā lokā devi tvaṃ viṣṇunā dhṛtā | tvaṃ ca dhāraya māṃ nityaṃ pavitraṃ kuru cāsanam ||26|| ityāmantryāsanaṃ mantrī tathā dhārādipañcabhiḥ | pūjayitvā tu tatraiva prāṅmukhaḥ sādhakottamaḥ ||27|| svastikāsanasaṃvisṭo vāmāṅghrighātanatrayam | ūrdhvatālatrayaṃ dattvā dṛṣṭyāpūjālayādbahiḥ ||28|| bhaumāntarīkṣadivyāṃstānvighnānniḥsārayeta||29|| tataḥ— astreṇa gandhapuṣpābhyāṃ karau saṃśodhya sādhakaḥ | punarastreṇa saṃprokṣya gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ jalaṃ tataḥ ||30|| amṛtīkṛtya mūlena kuryānmantritamuttamam | tataḥ sphoṭikayā kuryāddigbandhanamataḥ param ||31|| prākāratritayaṃ vahnervidhāya tasya madhyataḥ | sthitvācaredbhūtaśuddhiṃ yathākramamananyadhīḥ ||32|| jñānakarmendriyairbhūtaiḥ sūkṣmabhūtaiśca pañcabhiḥ | prakṛtyā manasā buddhyāpyahaṃkāreṇa śuddhadhīḥ ||33|| svasvakāryayutairjīvaṃ suṣumnāvartmanā tataḥ | nītvā brahmaṇi saṃyojya so'hamityeva yojayeta||34|| śūnyaṃ śarīraṃ saṃcintya vāyubījāni ṣoḍaśa | vāmanāsāpuṭe dhīmānjapanyatnena śuddhadhīḥ ||35|| vāmanāsāpuṭenaiva vāyamākṛṣya vāyunā | tena nābhisthitaṃ vāyumaṇḍalaṃ vardhayettataḥ ||36|| tena yatnena saṃśodhya vāmakukṣisthitaṃ punaḥ | puruṣaṃ pāpasaṃghātaṃ śyāmaṃ raktavilocanam ||37|| aṅguṣṭhaikamitaṃ duṣṭamadhomukhamataḥ param | stambhayitvānilaṃ yatnāccatuḥṣaṣṭhimitaṃ japana||38|| japandvātriṃśadvāraṃ taddakṣiṇena śanaistyajeta||39|| punardakṣiṇayā vāyumākṛṣya vahnimantrataḥ | stambhayitvāniklaṃ mantrīyogena kumbhakena hi ||40|| prajvālya vāyunā vahniṃ saṃdahya pāpadehinam | tadbhasmasahitaṃ vāyuṃ vāmayā saṃtyajedbahiḥ ||41|| vāmayā vāyumākṛṣya japannevendusaṃjñakam | bījaṃ madhyamanābhyāca lalāṭendau niyojya ca ||42|| vāruṇenaiva saṃstambhya vāyuṃ taccandramaṇḍalāta| vidhāyāmṛtadṛṣṭiṃ ca tayāmṛtīkṛtaṃ vapuḥ ||43|| vicintya śaktibījena śarīraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ punaḥ | bhāvayansantyajedvāyuṃ dakṣiṇenaiva vartmanā ||44|| pūrvasthāpitajīvādīnsve sve sthāne niyojayeta| haṃsa ityeṣa mantreṇa jīvanyāsaṃ tataścareta||45|| jīvanyāsamanuṃ vakṣye sarvakarmāṅgamuttamam | vedādirbindumānśeṣaḥ śaktiraṅkuśa eva ca ||46|| cādilāntaṃ sendukhaṇḍaṃ ho haṃsaḥ so'hameva ca | mama prāṇā iha prāṇāḥ punaḥ pūrvamanuṃ paṭhana||47|| mama jīva iha sthitaḥ punarevaṃ manuṃ paṭhana| mama vāṅmanastvagiti cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ tataḥ param ||48|| ghrāṇaprāṇā ihāgatya sukenaiva ciraṃ punaḥ | tiṣṭhantu vahnijāyā ca pūrvabījacatuṣṭayam ||49|| jīvanyāsamanuḥ proktastāntrikairmantravittamaiḥ ||50|| iti bhakticandrikāyāṃ prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ ! <2> atha dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ tato vai mātṛkānyāsamācaretsādhakottamaḥ | ṛṣirbrahmāsya mantrasya gāyatrīcchanda ucyate ||1|| mātā sarasvatī dhyeyā devatā kathyate budhaiḥ | halo bījāni tattvajñaiḥ śaktayo mantravittamaiḥ ||2|| svarāśca mātṛkānyāse viniyogastataḥ kramāta| śirovadanahṛdguhyapādeṣu nyasya pañcakam ||3|| brahmādisendubhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ svarayugmaiḥ śiro'ntagaiḥ | karāṅganyāsaṃ kurvīta tato dhyāyetsarasvatīm ||4|| pañcāśallipibhirvibhaktamukhadoḥpanmadhyavakṣaḥsthalāṃ bhāsvanmaulinibaddhacandraśakalāmāpīnatuṅgastanīm | mudrāmakṣaguṇaṃ sudhāḍhyakalasaṃ vidyāṃ ca hastāmbujair bibhrāṇāṃ viṣadaprabhāṃ trinayanāṃ vāgdevatāmāśraye ||5|| iti dhyātvā nyaseddehe mātṛkārṇānvicakṣaṇaḥ ||6|| śirasi vadanavṛtte cakṣuṣoḥ karṇayośca tadanu ca nasi yugme gaṇḍayoroṣṭhadeśe | adharadaśanayugme bhāladeśe ca vaktre svaravasuyugavarṇānvinyasedindrayuktāna||7|| karapadayugasandhiṣvagrato kādināntān śaśikalitapavargānpārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhanābhyoḥ | jaṭhara iti hṛdisthaṃ yaṃ ca raṃ dakṣiṇāṃse kakudi lamiti cāṃse vāmabhāge vameva ||8|| karadvaye padadvandve jaṭhare vaktrake punaḥ | hṛtpūrve vinyasetśādikṣāntānindivibhūṣitāna||9|| evamukteṣu deśeṣu savisargānsvarānhalaḥ | vinyasetpunareteṣu bindusargayutānapi | vinyasyanmātṛkāvarṇānevaṃ varṇatanurbhaveta||10|| tataḥ śrīvāsudevādinyāsaṃ kuryātsusādhakaḥ | asyaiva nyāsarājasya nārado munireva ca ||11|| gāyatrīchanda ityevaṃ vāsudevaśca devatā | bījaṃ praṇava eva syātsvāhā śaktiḥ prakīrtitā ||12|| adhiṣṭhātrī devatā syāddevī kātyāyanī sati | ācakrāyeti pañcāṅgaṃ kuryāddhyāyettataḥ param ||13|| dhyāyedātaptahemadyutiruciratamaṃ pītavastraṃ prasannam śrīvatsodbhāsi vakṣaḥsthalakalitalasatkaustubhaṃ divyabhūṣaṇam | hastāmbhojairdadhānaṃ darakamalagadācakramānandarūpam lakṣmyā juṣṭaṃ svageśāsanamamaramaṇiṃ vāsudevaṃ pareśam ||14|| dhyātvaivaṃ mātṛkārṇānāṃ mūrtīḥ śaktīśca vinyaseta| mantroddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi nyāsasya kramayogataḥ ||15|| praṇavo mātṛkāvarṇā mūrtiḥ śaktiśca ṅeyutā | vahnijāyānvito mantro varṇasthāne niyojitaḥ ||16|| lakṣmyā yukto vāsudevo'nantaḥ śaktyānvitaḥ smṛtaḥ | hṛṣīkeśaḥ śriyā yuktaḥ prītyā saṅkarṣaṇastathā ||17|| viṣṇuḥ padmālayāyukto vaikuṇṭho ramayā saha | mādhavaḥ kamalāyuktaḥ kāntyā kamalalocanaḥ ||18|| viśvayā viśvanātho'pi śāntyā viśveśvarastathā | nārāyaṇo viraktyā ca naro buddhyā samanvitaḥ ||19|| keśavaḥ kīrtisaṃyukto devakīnandanaśrutī | pareśaḥ parayā yuktaḥ parameṣṭhī ca śobhayā | śaktayo mūrtayaḥ proktāḥ svarāṇāṃ kramayogataḥ ||20|| atha vakṣye halāṃ mūrtīḥ śaktīśca yatnataḥ kramāta| durgāgadādharau cakrijaye śaṅkhadharastathā ||21|| vijayāsahito jñeyaḥ śarṅgī ca virajānvitaḥ | hariklinne vasumatī surau kṛṣṇavasundhare ||22|| govindavasude śaurivasudhe madhusūdanaḥ | sandhyāyutī dayāyukto vāmanaḥ śrīdharastathā ||23|| harṣayā sahito medhā sahitaśca trivikramaḥ | khaḍgiprabhe ca muṣalī caṇḍayā sahito'ṅkuśī ||24|| vilāsinī samāyukto varāhavigrahastathā | dharaṇī sahito ratyā pradyumno bhaktisaṃyutaḥ ||25|| satyaścedūsayā sārdhamaniruddhastatataḥ paraḥ | yajñeśaścomayā sārdhaṃ śrīrāmaḥ kṛpayānvitaḥ ||26|| ākṛṣṭyā sahito jñeyo jagannātho bhṛgūdvahaḥ | ugrayā sahitaḥ kūrmarūpī dhṛtyā yutaḥ punaḥ ||27|| vāṇīyuto hayagrīva ādyāyukto janārdanaḥ | mūrtyā balānujo bāla ṛddhyā śuddhyā gadāgrajaḥ ||28|| dāmodaraḥ puṣṭiyutastuṣṭiyukkamalekṣaṇaḥ | yajña āhutisaṃyuktastathorukrama eva ca ||29|| śraddhāyukto nṛsiṃhaśca saṃhṛtyā sahitastathā | yādyairdhātu prāṇajīvakrodhā apyātmane'ntakāḥ ||30|| evaṃ kṛte'dhikārī syātbhaktisādhanakarmaṇi | tasmādyatnena kartavyo nyāso'yaṃ bhaktisādhakaḥ ||31|| iti bhakticandrikāyāṃ dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ <3> tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ mantranyāsaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāsthānaṃ yathākramam | yena mantramayo dehastatkṣaṇādbhavati dhruvam ||1|| śirobhālamukhe kaṇṭhe hṛdaye jaṭhare tathā | nābhau dhvaje jānudeśe pādayorvinyasetkramāta||2|| mantravarṇāninduyuktānsādhakaḥ susamāhitaḥ | karayoraṅgulīṣveva mantrārṇānvinyasetsudhīḥ ||3|| tataḥ ṛṣyādikaṃ kuryādyathākramamananyadhīḥ | mantrasyāsya ṛṣiḥ prokto nāradaśchanda īritam ||4|| gāyatrī devatā kṛṣṇacaitanyo rasavigrahaḥ | bījaṃ tu kāmapremākhyaṃ svāhā śaktiḥ prakīrtitā ||5|| ādyā śaktiradhiṣṭhātrī devatā mantravittamaiḥ | śirovadanahṛddeśe dhvaje pāde ca sarvataḥ ||6|| gātreṣu vinyasetsādhye viniyogaḥ kramāditi | padāni pañcamantrāṅgakalpyānyatha manuṃ nyaseta||7|| mantrārṇaiḥ kalpayedaṅgaṃ kramayogena sādhakaḥ | kāmena kalpayedaṅgaṃ hṛdayāya namaḥ param ||8|| premṇā ca śirase svāhā śikhāyai vaṣaḍityapi | kṛṣṇeti kavacānṅe huṃ caitanyāyetyataḥ param ||9|| netratrayāya vauṣaṭsyātsvāhāstrāya phaḍityapi | sarvairmantrākṣarairevamaṅganyāso vidhīyate | evameva prakurvīta karanyāsaṃ samāhitam ||10|| tato varṇyena vidhinā svadehe pīṭhamarcayeta| uparyupari saṃcityaṃ hṛdi saṅkalpya tāravata||11|| ādhāraśaktaye mūlaprakṛtyai kūrma āyuyuka| anantāya pṛthivyai ca tataḥ kṣīrābdhaye namaḥ ||12|| śvetadvīpāya tatraiva ratnamaṇḍapa āyayuka| dakṣavāmāṃsayorūrvordharmajñānaṃ prapūjayeta||13|| vairāgyaṃ ca tathaiśvaryaṃ caturthyantaṃ tataḥ param | mukhe dhvaje pārśvayoścādharmamajñānameva ca ||14|| avairāgyamanaiśvaryaṃ pūjayenmaṇḍapāntare | dikṣu madhye kalpavṛkṣaṃ tadadhoratnavedikām ||15|| ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ tasminnānandakandameva ca | saṃvinnālaṃ ca kamalaṃ karṇikā keśarānvitam ||16|| śeṣaṃ tataḥ karṇikāyāṃ sūryendvanalamaṇḍalam | praṇavāṅgaiḥ samāyuktaṃ svakalāsahitaṃ tataḥ ||17|| sattvaṃ rajastamasendusvādyakṣarayutaṃ tathā | ātmānamantaḥ paramapūrvakaṃ ca saśaktikaḥ | jñānātmeti tataḥ śaktīḥ pīṭhasya ṣoḍaśaikataḥ ||18|| lakṣmīrvasumatī bhadrā vimalā kamalāmalā | arundhatī ca gāndhārī kṣamā śāntirharipriyā ||19|| ratiḥ kāntirdhṛtiḥ satyā subhadrā madhyabhāgataḥ | viṣṇupriyā ca vijñeyā etā vai pīṭhaśaktayaḥ ||20|| vedādihṛdayaṃ proktaṃ bhagavānvāsudevakaḥ | viṣṇurṅeyuktato brūyātsarvabhūtātmane tataḥ ||21|| sarvātmasaṃyogayogapadmapīṭhātmane namaḥ | ityevaṃ pīṭhamabhyarcya kṛtvā digbandhanaṃ punaḥ ||22|| svāṅke nyasyottānakarau dhyāyecchrīpuruṣottamam ||23|| svardhunītīramāsādya navadvīpe janālaye | brāhmaṇaiḥ paṇḍitairbhaṭṭairācāryaiścakravartibhiḥ ||24|| kavibhiḥ kavirājaiśca kāvyavidbhirvicakṣaṇaiḥ | vaidyairvaidyakaśāstrajñairjyotirvidbhiḥ samanvite ||25|| dātṛbhirjñānibhirdhanyairvedavidbhiśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ | karavīraṃ sitai raktaiḥ śatapatraiścaturvidhaiḥ ||26|| niṣevite punastatra kadambatarumūlataḥ | divyaṃ manoharaṃ sthānaṃ gandhavāyuniṣevitam ||27|| veṣṭitaṃ bhaktavaryaiśca tattadbhāvasamanvitaiḥ | karasthamālyayugmaiśca jayagaureti vādibhiḥ ||28|| kramātsaptāvṛtiyutairdivyaveśavibhūṣaṇaiḥ | tanmadhye vartate divyaṃ caturasraṃ sukhāsanam ||29|| bhaktibhāvasamāyuktastatrāsīnaṃ vicintayeta||30|| dhyāyedātaptajāmbunadaruciruciraṃ śuklaraktāntacīram divyāraktāsanasthaṃ smitavalitamukhāmbhojaraktadvinetram | śrīkhaṇḍāliptavakṣaḥsthalakalitalasanmālatīmālyayugmaṃ caitanyaṃ divyabhūṣaṃ dvijamukuṭamaṇiṃ bhaktamālābhiṣiktam ||31|| evaṃ dhyātvārcite pīṭhe hṛdayāmbhojamadhyataḥ | upaveśya svāgatādipraśnaṃ kṛtvā susādhakaḥ ||32|| manasā mūlamantreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ ca mastake | pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca madhuparkaṃ tataḥ param ||33|| iti bhakticandrikāyāṃ tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ <4> caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ atha bhaktimatīṃ dīkṣāṃ mantrasiddhyarthahetave | vakṣye śiṣyeṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ bhagavatprītikāriṇīm ||1|| yāmṛte mantrasiddhirna bhavetkoṭijapādibhiḥ | kalpe dṛṣṭvā na kadāpi japenmantraṃ vivakṣaṇaḥ ||2|| yathāsvaṃ dakṣiṇāvastu neha brahmāṇḍagocare | tatraivaṃ dakṣiṇā dehasamarpaṇavidhirvidhiḥ ||3|| tataḥ prathamataḥ śiṣyagurulakṣaṇamucyate ||4|| bhaktaṃ bhaktividhānatattvakathane niṣṇātamevānvaham brahmākhyānaparāyaṇaṃ bhagavatastattvaikaniṣṭhāpanam | śāntaṃ dāntamananyasādhanaparaṃ sadvāsanāsaṃyutaṃ bhaktyā śrīgurumāśrayedanugato'māyī suśānto'niśam ||5|| prapadyamāno gurumāha vākyaṃ praṇamya bhaktyā nijakarmadarśī | ahaṃ sadā duḥsahaduḥkhabhāgī dayāṃ kurusveti dayānidhe me ||6|| saṃsāramagnaṃ praṇataṃ dayāmbudhe trāyasva māṃ nityamananyadarśinam | svābhīṣṭasevāvidhimeva dehi me śiṣyaṃ prapannaṃ kuruśāsanaṃ hitam ||7|| māsarkṣatithivāre ca śubhe lagne samāhitaḥ | deśikaḥ saṃyamī dīkṣāvidhimārabhate svayam ||8|| vṛtaḥ śiṣyeṇa vāsobhirbhūṣaṇaiḥ puṣpacandanaiḥ | etairalaṅkṛto dhīro bhūmiṃ saṃśodhya yatnavāna||9|| tatrāsanaṃ pātayitvā cailājinakuśottaram | tadeva śodhayenmantrairmantrī baddhāñjaliḥ śuciḥ ||10|| merupṛṣṭhādibhiścātra mantrite svastikāsanam | baddhopaviśya prācīdigvadanaḥ sordhvapūṇḍrakaḥ ||11|| saṃmantrya gandhapuṣpādīnkarau tābhyāṃ ca śodhayeta| praṇamya vāmabhāge ca gurupaṅktīrgaṇādhipam ||12|| dakṣe'grato bhagavatīṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca paścime | nirvighno vidhivatkṛtvā tāladigbandhanādikam ||13|| bhūtaśuddhikrameṇaiva dehaśodhanamācarana| saṃsthāpya dehe jīvādīnkṛtanyāsavidhikramāta||14|| svadehe pīthamabhyarcya dhyānādeva mahāprabhum | tatra saṃsthāpya mūlena sampūjya manasā kramāta||15|| tasyāhaṃ tanmayo bhūtvā bahiḥ pūjāṃ samācarana| arghyasaṃsthāpanaṃ kuryādyathākramamatandritaḥ ||16|| triṣaṭcatuṣkoṇayutaṃ maṇḍalatrayamuttamam | uparyuparibhāgena bhuvi vāme likhetsudhīḥ ||17|| prakṣālya tripadīmastramanunā tatra maṇḍale | saṃsthāpya pūjayedbhaktyā gandhādyaiḥ susamāhitaḥ | vahnimaṇḍalarūpāṃ tāṃ vahnimaṇḍalamantrataḥ ||18|| tato'stramanunā śaṅkhaṃ prakṣālya sthāpayettataḥ | pūjayetsūryarūpaṃ taṃ sūryamaṇḍalamantrataḥ ||19|| gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ yavaṃ dūrvāṃ hṛdā śaṅkhe ca nikṣipeta| dakṣiṇasthajale dhīmānvilomenaiva mātṛkāḥ ||20|| tejaḥ svarūpāvijñāya prajapanninduniḥsṛtāḥ | tadyuktāmṛtabuddhyābjaṃ śirasā pūrayejjalaiḥ ||21|| tadbhāgaṃ somabuddhyā ca somamaṇḍalamantrataḥ | sampūjya tatra tīrthāni sthāpayetsūryamaṇḍalāta| tanmantreṇa samānīya hṛtpadyācca mahāprabhum ||22|| pradarśya gālinīṃ mudrāṃ śikhayā netramantrataḥ | svayaṃ vīkṣya varmaṇā ca jalaṃ tadavaguṇṭhayeta||23|| atha guṇṭhanamudrābhiḥ punastasyāgnikoṇataḥ | hṛdayāpi kavacānte netramagre ca vinyaseta||24|| dikṣvastramaṅgamantraistu pūjayettajjalaṃ kramāta| amṛtīkaraṇaṃ dhenumudrayā śaṅkhamudrikām ||25|| pradarśyācchādya yatnena tajjalaṃ matsyamudrayā | prajapannaṣṭadhā mūlamantramaikyaṃ ca bhāvayeta||26|| jalābjadevatānāṃ ca prasannātmā tataḥ param | śaṅkhasthajalabinduṃ ca dakṣiṇasthajale kṣipeta||27|| taccheṣeṇokṣayetpūjādravyamātmānameva ca | vāratrayaṃ tato mantrī ghaṭaṃ maṇḍalamadhyataḥ ||28|| guruvighneśvapīṭhārcānvite śālikuśopari | saṃveṣṭya kṣaumayugmena satāraṃ vidhivannyaseta||29|| pañcaratnaṃ pañcagavyaṃ pañcāmṛtamataḥ param | kuśakūrcāstathā śvetaprasūnākṣatapallavāna||30|| pratyekameva mantreṇa mūlena nikṣipedghaṭe | karpūrāvāsinaṃ nīraṃ mātṛkāmayamuttamam ||31|| sudhāsvarūpakaṃ svacchaṃ triśca japtaṃ svamantrataḥ | kṣīradrumādikvathambā nītvā śaṅkhāntaraṃ punaḥ ||32|| tena sampūrya mūlena tripadāṃ tatra samjapeta| gaṅgādisarvatīrthāni samudrānsarvadevatāḥ | āvāhya sthāpayettatra kṣiptvā gandhāṣṭakaṃ kalāḥ ||33|| sampūjya vidhivatsarvāghaṭe sarvaṃ payaḥ kṣipeta| ācchādya vidhinābhyarcedghaṭaṃ sarvamayaṃ tataḥ ||34|| yantrasvarṇādipātrasthaṃ likhitaṃ sumanoharam | ghaṭe saṃsthāpya tatraivādhārādīṃścābhipūjayeta||35|| vasuyugmadalopetaṃ kamalaṃ keśarānvitam | sakarṇikaṃ caturdvāratoraṇāñcitamuttamam ||36|| rekhātrayasamāyuktaṃ vasuvajrasamanvitam | candanāliptapātre ca likhetsvarṇaśalākayā ||37|| caturasraṃ karṇikāyāmāsanaṃ madhyadeśataḥ | premabījaṃ likhettatra bahiḥ ṣaṭkoṇamuttamam ||38|| ṣaḍgahvare kāmabījaṃ catuṣkoṇe bhuvaḥ punaḥ | caitanyānandanāmānamimaṃ yantraṃ vilikhya ca ||39|| svarṇapātre kuṅkumena dhārayedyaḥ samāhitaḥ | bhaktirbhāgavatī premalakṣaṇā tasya sidhyati ||40|| uparyupari tatraiva kramādādhāraśaktikāna| sampūjya pūrvavaddhyātvā bhagavantaṃ hṛdisthitam ||41|| mūlahṛdbhālakamale tejastrayamanuttamam | taḍillatābhaṃ tatraikīkṛtya premnā tato bahiḥ ||42|| niḥsārya kiṃcitsaṃsthāpya bhaktyā pūjāsane tataḥ | mūlena mūrtiṃ saṅkalpya tata āvāhayetpunaḥ ||43|| āvāhanyādibhirmantrīmudrābhiraṣṭabhistathā | saṃsthāpya mūlamantreṇa dadyādarghyaṃ prakalpitam ||44|| tataḥ pādyādibhirdevaṃ sampūjya vidhivatsudhīḥ | tatraiva añjalibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ pādahṛdmastake punaḥ ||45|| vakṣe vāme ca sarvāṅge tulasyādibhirarcayeta| karavīrāmbujaiḥ śuklai raktai taccandanānvitaiḥ ||46|| evaṃ sampūjya vidhivadaṅgādyāvaraṇaṃ tataḥ | pūjayedgandhapuṣpādyaiḥ krameṇa vidhivannaraḥ | tatrānujñāṃ prabhoḥ prārthya kṣipettryañjalimūlataḥ ||47|| āgneyādicatuṣkoṇe caturasrāsanasya ca | sampūjya puṣpagandhābhyāṃ hṛdayādyaṅgadevatāḥ ||48|| netramagre caturdikṣu pūrvādiṣvastradevatāḥ | raktaśyāmapāṭhalābhaśuklakṛṣṇānalaprabhāḥ ||49|| suvarṇavasanālepayuktā divyavibhūṣaṇāḥ | varābhītikarādhyeyāḥ premasnigdhekṣaṇāḥ śubhāḥ ||50|| tadbahiḥ ṣaṭsu koṇeṣu pūjyo'gre dvijanandanaḥ | gadādharo dakṣabhāge nyāsī dāmodarastathā ||51|| vāme śrīmannarahariḥ paścāddāso gadādharaḥ | dakṣe datto vāsudevaḥ śivānandaśca vāmataḥ ||52|| premnā prabhumukhāmbhojaprekṣakāḥ pulakākulāḥ | divyamālyakarāmbhojā ete pūjyā vidhānataḥ ||53|| tadbahiḥ keśareṣvagre nityānando jagatpatiḥ | ācāryādvaitanāmāpi murāriśrīnivāsakau ||54|| purī syānmādhavo jñeyaḥ paramānanda eva ca | brahmānando'pi sannyāsī nṛsiṃhānanda ityapi ||55|| bhāratī keśavo jñeyaḥ sarvavidyāviśāradaḥ | govindānando govindadāso vakreśvarastataḥ ||56|| haridāso mukundaśca rāmaḥ saṅgītatatparaḥ | haridāso dvijavaraḥ sarve candanamālinaḥ ||57|| harināmaparāḥ kecitkecittannāmatatparāḥ | premāṅkurasamāyuktāḥ premāśrunayanojjvalāḥ ||58|| tadbahiḥ patramadhye ca sārvabhaumastataḥ param | vallabho jagadānando mukundo raghunandanaḥ ||59|| jagannāthaḥ śacīdevī govindaghoṣa eva ca | kāśīśvaraḥ kṛṣṇadāsaḥ śrīdāmadāsa eva ca ||60|| sundarānandanāmādi parameśvaradāsakaḥ | puruṣottamadāsaḥ syādgaurīdāsastataḥ param ||61|| kamalākarastato'bhyarcaḥ sarve divyānulepanāḥ | dhyeyā divyāmbarāḥ premarasavihvalacetasaḥ ||62|| patre tadbahiḥpūjyā jñānānandastataḥ param | ghoṣaśrīvāsudevaśca pratāparudra eva ca ||63|| rāmānando rāghavaśca pradyumnaḥ śrīsudarśanaḥ | vāṇīnātho viṣṇudāso dāmodarapurandarau ||64|| ācāryacandro bhagavāncandraśekhara eva ca | candaneśvaranāmāpi paṇḍitaḥ śrīdhanañjayaḥ ||65|| sarve bhāgavatā gaurapremavihvalamānasāḥ | harināmaratā dhyeyā divyamālyakarāmbujāḥ ||66|| tadbahirdikṣu dikpālāḥ pūjyā bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ | tattadbījādiyuktāśca tattadvarṇavibhūṣaṇāḥ ||67|| indro'gniryama ityeva nairṛto varuṇastathā | vāyuḥ kuvera īśāno dikṣvananto'dha ūrdhvataḥ ||68|| lokeśastadbahirdikṣu tadastrāṇi prapūjayeta| vajrādīnyaṣṭamūrtāni cakrābje tvadha ūrdhvayoḥ ||69|| prabhoḥ pārṣadarūpāṇi svalakṣmāḍhyāni mauliṣu | tato nāmāṣṭakenāpi tasmai puṣpāñjalīndiśeta||70|| iti sampūjya dhūpaṃ ca dīpaṃ naivedyamagrataḥ | sthāpayitvāstramantreṇa samprokṣya śoṣaṇādibhiḥ ||71|| vāyubījādibhirvāmapāṇinā śodhayetpunaḥ | saṃrakṣya cakramudrābhirdhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtam ||72|| japtaṃ mūlenāṣṭakṛtvastulasyā pūjitaṃ kṛtī | nivedya mūlamantreṇa ghaṇṭāṃ tanmantramantritām ||73|| vādayanvāmahastena nīcairdadyātpunaḥ punaḥ | dhūpamāpādamāmauli saptavāraṃ pradarśayeta||74|| dīpaṃ gṛhītvā naivedyaṃ tannivedanamudrayā | tanmantreṇaiva parayā bhaktyā śrīprabhave'rpayeta||75|| nivedayāmi bhavate juṣāṇedaṃ havirhare | sthāpayitvā punarbhūmau karpūravāsitaṃ param ||76|| gaṇḍūṣaṃ dattvā mantreṇa grāsamudrāṃ pradarśayeta| savyena cotpalākāraṃ dakṣeṇa pañcamudrikāḥ ||77|| yathākramaṃ bhojayitvā hutvā ca vidhivadbalim | grahādibhyaḥ samarpyātha punargaṇḍūṣamādarāta| dattvāgre triḥ karma kuryātsvārpaṇāntaṃ tato nyaseta||78|| saṃhāramudrayā devaṃ hṛdi saṃsthāpya yatnavāna| viṣvaksenāya nirmālyaṃ dattvā kiṃcitsvayaṃ tataḥ ||79|| gṛhītvā tanmayo bhūtvā sarvaṃ smṛtvā cidātmakam | ghaṭe saṃyojya taṃ spṛṣṭvā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ japana||80|| kṛtopavāsaṃ pūrvedyuḥ śiṣyamānīya vāmataḥ | bhūtaśuddhyādikaṃ kṛtvā ghaṭaṃ nītvā tathāntike ||81|| devaṃ prārthyamantrapūtaiścābhisiñcedghaṭodakaiḥ ||82|| dhṛtvāṃśuke athācamya bhaktyāsīnasya sannidhau | vicintya devaṃ hṛdaye deśikasuprasannadhīḥ ||83|| pūjayitvā arghyapādyādyairātmānaṃ śiṣyameva ca | vāsasācchādya rudrākṣaṃ divyadṛṣṭyāvalokayana||84|| nyasya mūrdhni karaṃ tasya dakṣakarṇe manuṃ vadeta| vidhivadvāratritayaṃ sa caikyaṃ bhāvayanpaṭheta||85|| gurudaivatamantrāṇāṃ tatastasya kare'rpayeta| samānaphalado'stveṣa āvayormantra ityapi ||86|| tulasīsahitaṃ nīraṃ śiṣyaḥ svasti bravītviti | labdhvā śubhrāśiṣo'nyacca jāyate pūrvamānasaḥ ||87|| yathāśakti japenmantraṃ guruḥ śiṣyaśca śāntadhīḥ | vinayāvanatastasmācchikṣeta samayādikam ||88|| tataḥ śiṣyo gurubhaktyā kāñcanādidhanena ca | santoṣya vidhivadbhūmau praṇametpunaḥ punaḥ | dehasamarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā toṣayedgurumādarāta||89|| gururbrahmā guru viṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ | gurureva paraṃ brahma tasmādādau tamarcayeta||90|| ajñānatimirāndhasyetyādinā praṇametsada| ekamapyakṣaraṃ yastu guruḥ śiṣye nivedayeta||91|| yatkiṃcidannapānādipriyaṃ dravyaṃ manoramam | nivedya gurave paścātsvayaṃ bhuñjīta pratyaham ||92|| śiṣyaḥ śānto yatātmā ca guru bhaktirataḥ sadā | vratī satyavacānityaṃ japenmantraṃ prayatnataḥ ||93|| eteṣāṃ mantracaryāṇāṃ daśalakṣyaṃ japetsudhīḥ | homastasya daśāṃśena tarpaṇaṃ taddaśāṃśataḥ ||94|| abhiṣekastaddaśāṃśo brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayettataḥ | daśāṃśavidhinā yuktaḥ puraścaryāvidhaiḥ kramāta||95|| iti bhakticandrikāyāṃ caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ <5> pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ atha stotraṃ pravakṣyāmi pratyaṅgavarṇanaṃ prabhoḥ | trikālaṃ paṭhanādeva premabhaktiṃ labhennaraḥ ||1|| kaścicchrīkṛṣṇacaitanyasmaraṇākulamānasaḥ | pulakāvacitāṅgo'pi sakampāśruvilocanaḥ ||2|| kathaṃcitsthairyamālambya praṇamya gurumādarāta| stotumārabdhavānbhaktyā dvijacandraṃ mahāprabhum ||3|| taptahemadyutiṃ vande kalikṛṣṇaṃ jagadgurum | cārudīrghatanuṃ śrīmacchacīhṛdayanandanam ||4|| lasanmuktālatānaddhacārukuñcitakuntalam | śikhaṇḍākṣatagandhāḍhya puṣpagucchāvataṃsakam ||5|| ardhacandrollasadbhālakastūrītilakāṅkitam | bhaṅgurabhrūlatākelijitakāmaśarāsanam ||6|| premapravāhamadhuraraktotpalavilocanam | tilaprasūnasusnigdhanūtanāyatanāsikam ||7|| śrīgaṇḍamaṇḍalollāsiratnakuṇḍalamaṇḍitam | savyakarṇasuvinyastasphuraccāruśikhaṇḍakam ||8|| madhurasmitasusnigdhaprāraktādharapallavam | īṣaddanturitasnigdhasphuranmuktāradojjvalam ||9|| sapremamadhurālāpavaśīkṛtajagajjanam | trikoṇacibukaṃ koṭiśaradinduprabhānanam ||10|| siṃhagrīvaṃ mahāmattadviradollāsikandharam | āraktarekhātrayayukkambukaṇṭhamanoharam ||11|| muktā prabālakalitahārojjvalitavakṣasam | kaṅkaṇāṅgadavidyotijānulambitabhujadvayam ||12|| yavacakrāṅkitāraktaśrīmatpāṇitalojjvalam | svarṇamudrālasacchrīmadvimalāṅgulipallavam ||13|| candanāgurususnigdhaṃ pulakāvalicarcitam | cārunābhilasanmadhyaṃ siṃhamadhyakṛśodaram ||14|| vicitracitravasanamadhyabandhollasadvalim | sucārunūpurollāsikūjaccaraṇapallavam ||15|| śaraccandrapratīkāśanakharājatpadāṅgulim | aṅkuśadhvajavajrādilasattalapadāmbujam ||16|| koṭisūryapratīkāśaṃ koṭīndulalitadyutim | koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaṃ koṭilīlāmanoramam ||17|| sākṣāllīlātanuṃ kelitanuṃ śṛṅgāravigraham | kvacidbhāvakalāmūrtiṃ prasphuratpremavigraham ||18|| nāmātmakaṃ nāmatanuṃ paramānandavigraham | bhaktyātmakaṃ bhaktitanuṃ bhaktyācāravihāriṇam ||19|| aśeṣakelilāvaṇyaṃ līlātāṇḍavapaṇḍitam | śacījaṭhararatnābdhisamudbhūtasudhānidhim ||20|| aśeṣajagadānandakandamadbhutamaṅgalam | sphuradrāsarasāveśamadālasavilocanam ||21|| kvacidbhaktajanairdivyamālyagandhānulepanaiḥ | veṣṭitaṃ rasasaṅgītaṃ gāyadbhī rasalālasam ||22|| kvacidbālyarasāveśagaṅgātīre vihāriṇam | kvacidgāyati gāyantaṃ nṛtyantaṃ karaśabditaiḥ ||23|| vadantaṃ śabdamatyuccaiḥ kurvantaṃ siṃhavikramam | kvacidāsphoṭahuṅkārakampitāśeṣabhūtalam ||24|| suguptagopikābhāvaprakāśitajagattrayam | prāpitāśeṣapuruṣastrīsvabhāvamanākulam ||25|| nijabhāvarasāsvādavivaśaikādaśendriyam | vidagdhanāgarībhāvakalākelimanoramam ||26|| gadādharapremabhāvakalākrāntamanoratham | naraharipremarasāsvādavihvalamānasam ||27|| sarvabhāgavatāhūtakāntābhāvaprakāśakam | premapradānalalitadvibhujaṃ bhaktavatsalam ||28|| premākhyapadadvandvaṃ śrīpremabhaktimandiram | nijabhāvarasollāsamugdhīkṛtajagattrayam ||29|| svanāmajapasaṅkhyābhirvaiṣṇavīkṛtabhūtalam | navadvīpajanānandaṃ bhūdevajanamaṅgalam ||30|| aśeṣajīvasadbhāgyakramasambhūtasatphalam | bhayānurāgasusnehabhaktigamyapadāmbujam ||31|| naṭarājaśiroratnaṃ śrīnāgaraśiromaṇim | aśeṣarasikasphūryanmaulibhūṣaṇabhūṣaṇam ||32|| rasikānugatasnigdhavadanābjamadhuvratam | śrīmaddvijakulottaṃsaṃ navadvīpavibhūṣaṇam ||33|| premabhaktirasonmattādvaitasevyapadāmbujam | nityānandapriyatamaṃ sarvabhaktamanoratham ||34|| bhaktārādhyaṃ bhaktisādhyaṃ bhaktarūpiṇamīśvaram | śrīnivāsādibhaktāgraiḥ stūyamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ | sārvabhaumādibhirvedaśāstrāgamaviśāradaiḥ ||35|| ya evaṃ cintayeddevadeveśaṃ prayato'niśam | saṃstauti bhaktibhāvena trisandhyaṃ nityameva ca ||36|| dharmārthī labhate dharmaṃ śrībhāgavatamuttamam | arthārthī labhate cārthaṃ kṛṣṇasevāvidhau ratim ||37|| kāmārthī labhate kāmaṃ premabhaktividhānataḥ | saṃsāravāsanāmuktiṃ mokṣārthī vigataspṛhaḥ ||38|| vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ kāmasaṃsārakṛntanīm | kāvyārthī kavitāśaktiṃ kṛṣṇavarṇanaśālinīm ||39|| aputro vaiṣṇavaṃ putraṃ labhate lokavanditam | āśrayārthī labhecchāntaṃ śrīmadbhāgavataṃ gurum ||40|| śrīmacchrīkṛṣṇacaitanyapādāmbuje bhṛśam | premānurāgalalitāṃ sadbhaktiṃ labhate naraḥ ||41|| iti bhakticandrikāyāṃ pratyaṅgavarṇano nāma pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ <6> ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ atha vakṣye mantravarānsarvakāmārthasiddhidāna| kṛṣṇacaitanyacandrasya premabhaktisusiddhaye ||1|| kṛṣṇeti dvyakṣaro mantraścaitanyatryakṣaro mataḥ | caturvarṇo mantravaro ṅeyuktryakṣara eva ca ||2|| sa ca pañcākṣaro jñeyaḥ premādirmanuruttamaḥ | premasampuṭito jñeyaścaitanya iti pañcamaḥ ||3|| kāmādiścetpañcamaḥ syātṣaḍakṣara itīritaḥ | ṣaḍakṣaro manmathānto manuḥ saptākṣaro mataḥ ||4|| viśvambharāya premādiḥ kāmānotmanuruttamaḥ | syācchacīnandano ṅeyugvahnijāyāntako manuḥ ||5|| aṣṭakṣaro mantravaraḥ premākhyādirnavākṣaraḥ | daśākṣaro manmathādirmantrarājaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||6|| eteṣāṃ nārado jñeyo muniśchando virāḍiti | devatā kṛṣṇacaitanyo bījaṃ premākhyamuttamam ||7|| śaktirvahnivadhūḥ proktā sādyādhiṣṭhātṛdevatā | premākhyena hi ṣaḍdīrghabhājā syādaṅgakalpanā ||8|| prātaḥ kṛtyādikaṃ karmayarthāpūrvaṃ samācareta| padmaṃ vasudalopetaṃ karṇikākeśarānvitam ||9|| ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhenmadhye bījaṃ tatra likhetpunaḥ | tatra sampūjayedbhaktyā bhagavantaṃ susādhakaḥ ||10|| śrīmanmauktikadāmabaddhacikuraṃ susmeracandrānanam | śrīkhaṇḍāgurucārucitravasanasragdivyabhūṣaṇāñcitam ||11|| nṛtyāveśarasānumodamadhuraṃ kandarpaveśojjvalam | caitanyaṃ kanakadyutiṃ nijajanaiḥ saṃsevyamānaṃ bhaje ||12|| dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayennityaṃ bahiraṅgaistato bahiḥ | dikpālāstrāṇi sampūjya japenmantraṃ susādhakaḥ ||13|| lakṣaikasaṅkhyayā prokto japo homādayaḥ kramāta||14|| punaranyamanuṃ vakṣye sarvasiddhiphalapradam | vedādihṛdbhagavate kṛṣṇacaitanya eva ca ||15|| ṅeyuto mantrarājo'yaṃ trayādhikadaśākṣaraḥ | munirbrahmā virāṭchando devatānyāsirūpadhṛka||16|| caitanyaḥ paramānandaḥ praṇavo bījamuttamam | namaḥ śaktirviniyogo bhaktisiddhyartha ityapi ||17|| ācakrāyāgnidayitā hṛdayāya namo hṛdi | vicakrāyānalavadhūḥ śirase vahnināgarī ||18|| sucakrāyāgnivaradā śikhāyaiva ṣaḍityapi | trailokyarakṣaṇopetacakrāyāgnipriyā tataḥ ||19|| kavacāya tathā varma tvasurāntakapūrvakam | cakraṃ punaścaturthyantaṃ svāhāstrāya tathāstrakam ||20|| nārācamudrayā kuryāddhvanitritayameva ca | evamaṅgādinā kuryātkaranyāsaṃ susaṃyamī | aparaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā dhyāyedhṛdayapaṅkaje ||21|| atyantātaptahemadyutiruciratanuṃ dīrghadehākṣibāhuṃ śrīkhaṇḍāliptavakṣaḥsthalakalitatalasanmālatīmālyayugmam | āraktābhāsavāsoyugalalitavapurnāṭyalīlākalāḍhyaṃ vande caitanyacandraṃ sakalakaluṣahaṃ premabhaktyekagamyam ||22|| dhātvaivaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā bhagavantaṃ janārdanam | aṅgairdikpatibhiḥ sārdhaṃ vajrādhyaiśca yathākramam ||23|| evamārādhito devadeveśaḥ sādhakottamaiḥ | viraktisahitāṃ bhaktiṃ dadāti tatkṣaṇātprabhuḥ ||24|| premākhyasya manorvakṣye pūjāvidhimatho kramāta| ṛṣirbrahmānuṣṭupcchando devatā premavigrahaḥ ||25|| viśvambharo bījamantrapremākhyaṃ svayameva ca | śaktirvahnivadhūḥ prokto viniyogaḥ svakarmaṇi ||26|| ṣaḍdīrghabhājā premnā ca kuryādevāṅgakalpanām | yathāvidhi karanyāsaṃ kṛtvādhyāyetsamāhitaḥ ||27|| dhyāyedbālaṃ prasannaṃ taruṇaravikarābhāsamānaṃ samantāt kroḍasthaṃ māturaddhā prakaṭitaparamānandamāloladeham | devaṃ viśvambharaṃ taṃ kalikaluṣaharaṃ divyaviprāṅganābhiḥ premnā saṃvīkṣyamāṇaṃ vihasitavadanaṃ raktanetrotpalāḍhyam ||28|| dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā pādyārghyādyairyathākramam ||29|| aṅgavahnyādikoṇe tadanu ca paritaḥ keśareṣveva mātèr divyālaṅkārayuktāḥ suvimalavasanāḥ pūjayedbhaktiyukaḥ | pūjyā bhaktirvibhūtistribhuvanajananī śrīśacīkāntirādyā śāntiḥ śaktiśca dhātrī tadanudalagatātpūjayedgandhapuṣpaiḥ ||30|| nityānandastathādvaito murāriḥ śrīnivāsakaḥ | jagannāthastathā jñeyaḥ sudarśana iti smṛtaḥ ||31|| gadādharaśca vikhyātaḥ khyāto naraharistathā | divyamālyāmbaradharāḥ pulakāśrubharākulāḥ ||32|| patrāgre viprapatnyaśca pūjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ | mādhavī vaiṣṇavī devī śubhadā sundarī satī ||33|| kālindī lalitā divyavāso'laṅkāracarcitāḥ | gaurīśyāmā kramājjñeyāḥ prativeśivarāṅganāḥ | tadbahirdikṣu bhaktāgryāḥ pūjanīyā vidhānataḥ ||34|| vāsudevo mukundaśca rāmaḥ śaṅkara eva ca | nīlāmbaro rāmadāsakavicandrastataḥ param ||35|| haridāsastathā candraśekharācārya eva ca | divyamālyāmbaradharāḥ sarve saṅgītatatparāḥ ||36|| tadbahirdikṣu dikpālānvajrādīṃśca tato bahiḥ | pūrvoktayantre sampūjya daśalakṣaṃ japedbudhaḥ ||37|| iti bhakticandrikāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ <7> saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ atha mantravaraṃ vakṣye dvātriṃśadakṣarānvitam | sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvadurvāsanānalam ||1|| caturvargapradaṃ saumyaṃ bhaktidaṃ premapūrvakam | durbuddhiharaṇaṃ śuddhasattvabuddhipradāyakam ||2|| sarvārādhyaṃ sarvasevyaṃ sarveṣāṃ kāmapūrakam | sarvādhikārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvalokaikabāndhavam ||3|| sarvākarṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ duṣṭavyādhivināśanam | dīkṣāvidhivihīnaṃ ca kālākālavivarjitam ||4|| vāṅmātreṇārcitaṃ bāhyapūjāvidhyanapekṣakam | jihvāsparśanamātreṇa sarveṣāṃ phaladāyakam | deśakālāniyamitaṃ sarvavādisusammatam ||5|| tasyoddhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi samāhitamanāḥ śṛṇu | hare dvandvaṃ tathā kṛṣṇadvandvaṃ vyutkramaṇātpunaḥ ||6|| harerāmadvayaṃ paścādvilomenaiva tatpaṭheta| sarvāghaharṇāddhetorharirityabhidhīyate ||7|| bhaktiyogena sarveṣāṃ jīvākarṣaṇakāraṇāta| kṛṣṇa ityucyate sadbhiḥ śuddhasattvatanuḥ prabhuḥ ||8|| rāmo'pi lokaramaṇātsaṃsāracchedakārakaḥ | tasmānmokṣaprado rāmaḥ sarvaśāstreṣu kathyate ||9|| sambodhanapriyaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sambodhanapadakramāta| mantro'yaṃ vihitastena tatra premā niyojitaḥ ||10|| sarvanāmasvarūpo'yaṃ dehasvarūpa eva ca | tatraikatra yadi premā sobhayatra tadā bhavīta||11|| caturyuge bhavedbhaktirmuktiścaiva caturyuge | tena nāmāni catvāri catvāri kṛṣṇarāmayoḥ ||12|| bhaktisādhanataḥ pāpanāśo'tha muktisādhanāta| tatrobhayatra nāmāni hareścatvāri nāmataḥ ||13|| sambodhanapadaṃ śrutvā prabhustatra samāgataḥ | kiṃ prārthate bhaktajanaistadeva dātumudyataḥ ||14|| etairna prārthyate kiṃcinnāmaśravaṇayogataḥ | vasetteṣāṃ ca hṛdaya itthambhūtaguṇo hariḥ ||15|| mantre muktividhānārthaṃ rāmanāmaniyojitam | dvayorvirodhātbhaktānāṃ vidheyaṃ kiṃ taducyatām ||16|| ādau bhaktyā bhavenmuktiḥ saṃsāracchedakāriṇī | tathā bhāgavatī bhaktiḥ premalakṣaṇalakṣitā ||17|| tathā ca— na vinā bhaktiyogena muktiḥ sthādbhavasāgarāta| tāṃ ṛte premadā bhaktirna kadācitprabhoḥ pade ||18|| avidyā sukhaduḥkhānāṃ vināśādvidyayā yutaḥ | jīvanmuktaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ premabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ | amunā manunā caitatsādhyasādhanatatparaḥ ||19|| tatsādhanaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvidhikramādiha | nityānando muniḥ prokto'nuṣṭubchanda udāhṛtaḥ ||20|| paramāsvarūpaḥ śrīcaitanya eva daivatam | kṛṣṇanāmeti bījaṃ syādbhaktiḥ śaktirudāhṛtā ||21|| ādyā śaktiradhiṣṭhātrī devatā premarūpiṇī | eteṣāṃ viniyogaḥ syātpremasiddhau prabhoḥ pade ||22|| aṅganyāsaṃ prakurvīta mantravarṇavibhāgataḥ | hare kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa hṛdayāya namastataḥ ||23|| kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇeti śirase svāhā caiva hare hare | śikhāyai vaṣaḍityeva kavacāya humityataḥ ||24|| hare rāma hare rāma netrābhyāṃ vauṣaḍityapi | rāma rāmeti vijñeyamastrāya phaṭtataḥ param ||25|| hare hare tataḥ kuryātkaranyāsamiti kramāta||26|| tato yantraṃ likhenmantrī padmaṃ ṣoḍaśapatrakam | rekhātrayasamāyuktaṃ dvāratoraṇasaṃyutam ||27|| akṣaradvayamānena mantravarṇānlikheddale | ṣaṭkoṇaṃ vilikhenmadhye karṇikāyāṃ vidhānataḥ ||28|| premākhyaṃ madhyadeśe ca kāmaṃ bījaṃ ca koṇataḥ | etasminnnapi yantre cāpyādhārādīnprapūjya ca | tatraiva sthāpayeddhyātvā yathāvidhikramāditi ||29|| kanakarucirabhāsaḥ śuddhasattvaikaveśo nijasumadhuranāmākhyānadānaikadakṣaḥ | satatamavatu viśvaṃ śrīnavadvīpacandro nijaparijanavīto dīnabandhurdvijendraḥ ||30|| dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā paramātmānamavyayam ||31|| koṇāgradikṣu deśe ca pūjayedaṅgadevatāḥ | ṣaṭkoṇasyāgrabhāge ca sa sampūjyā bhaktisaṃyutāḥ ||32|| nityānando'dvaitanāmā murāriḥ śrīnivāsakaḥ | kāśīśvaro mukundaśca tataḥ keśaramadhyataḥ ||33|| gadādharo dvijavarastathā narahariḥ priyaḥ | dāmodaro vāsudevaḥ śivānandagadādharau ||34|| rāgahavaśrīrāmadāsau sundarānandaśārṅgiṇau | gaurīdāsastataḥ pūjyaḥ parameśvara eva ca ||35|| puruṣottamadāso'pi tathā vṛndāvanāśrayaḥ | govindo vāsudevaśca kamalākara eva ca ||36|| tadbahiḥ patramadhye ca vaiṣṇavā bhaktitatparāḥ | gopīnātho maheśaśca śuklāmbarasanātanau ||37|| jagāyimādhavau jñeyau vāsudevācyutāvapi | dikṣu pūjyāḥ prayatnena premāśrupulakācitāḥ ||38|| jaya gaurāṅga gaurāṅga jaya viśvambhara prabho | iti vādaratā nityaṃ premagadgadabhāṣiṇaḥ ||39|| patrāgre tadbahiḥ pūjyāḥ yadunandana eva ca | gaṅgādāsaḥ keśavaśca kṛṣṇadāsastataḥ param ||40|| raghunāthaviśvanāthau nīlāmbarasanātanau | divyamālyakarāḥ saumyāḥ premāśrupulakākulāḥ | tato'nyāvaraṇānyeva pūrvavatparipūjayeta||41|| koṭyekajapamātreṇa puraścaraṇamucyate | daśāṃśahomasaṅkhyānāṃ caturguṇavidhānataḥ ||42|| japaṃ kuryātprayatnena kāÿasaṅkhyā na vidyate | mālayā kararekhābhirjapetsādhakasattamaḥ ||43|| vidhirmantrajape proktaḥ ṣaṣṭhidaṇḍātmakaṃ dinam | snānādyapekṣā nāstyatra yathāśakyaṃ karotu vā | ityevaṃ sādhayenmantraṃ sa eva sādhakottamaḥ ||44|| iti bhakticandrikāyāṃ saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ <8> aṣṭaḥ paṭalaḥ mantrāṇāṃ sādhanaṃ vakṣye sakāmānāṃ viśeṣataḥ | yenaiva sādhyate sarvakarmasiddhirayatnataḥ ||1|| vāgbhavādyena mantreṇa śuklapadmena pratyaham | vāgbhavaprakṛtiṃ devaṃ rātriśeṣe viśeṣataḥ ||2|| suklena candanenaiva dhūpadīpādibhistathā | sampūjya māsamekaṃ ca sahasraṃ prajapanmanūna| labhate sarvavidyāṃ ca kavitvaṃ nirmalaṃ sudhīḥ ||3|| śrīpūrveṇaiva manunā śrīśaṃ gauraṃ samarcayana| sitaśrīkhaṇḍapaṅkopaliptena kusumena ca ||4|| karavīrodbhavenaiva sitenaikaśatena ca | prabhāte pratyahaṃ māsamekaṃ mantrī prayatnataḥ | japansahasratanmantrānsampattiṃ labhate na kaḥ ||5|| śaktipūrveṇa manunā sarvaśaktisamanvitam | gauracandraṃ samārādhya putrakāmo jitendriyaḥ ||6|| sitāsarpiḥ samāyuktaiḥ raktapadmaiḥ samāhitaḥ | hutvāyutadvayaṃ vahnau yonikuṇḍe samācite ||7|| sahasraikapramāṇena tathā mantraṃ japanśuciḥ | vatsarābhyantare putraṃ labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ śucim ||8|| jvarādipīḍitānāṃ ca grastānāṃ vyādhisaṅkaṭaiḥ | śiraḥ spṛṣṭvā japenmantraṃ nṛsiṃhādyakṣarānvitam | sahasraṃ vyādhibhirmukto bhavedeva tadā naraḥ ||9| praṇavādyena tenaiva tattvajijñāsurātmanaḥ | nyāsiveśotsavaṃ gauracandraṃ bhaktyā samāhitaḥ ||10|| tulasīmālatījātikusumaiścandanokṣitaiḥ | samārādhya japaṃ lakṣaṃ kurvanmantrī jitendriyaḥ ||11|| labhate paramāṃ śāntiṃ saṃsāracchedakāriṇīm | viśiṣṭamuttamaṃ jñānaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||12|| vaśībhavejjagatsarvaṃ sarve syurbāndhavā narāḥ | premasiddhiḥ karasthā syājjñānavijñānasaṃyutā ||13|| ekaikaṃ kāmyamuddiśya japapūjāsvatantratā | svāśramācārakauśalyaṃ brahmacaryādikaṃ vidhiḥ ||14|| evaṃ siddhimanuḥ prātaḥ śatajaptaṃ jalaṃ pibeta| māsamekaṃ mitāhārī bhavecchrutidharastadā ||15|| atha siddhaprayogavidhiḥ atha siddhaprayogo'pi likhyate sādhusammataḥ | yadyogājjapamātreṇa sidhyatyeva manurmataḥ ||16|| puṭitaṃ praṇavenaiva mantraṃ kṛtvā japetsudhīḥ | lakṣamekaṃ haviṣyāśī tadā siddhamanurbhaveta||17|| vāgbhavāntaritaṃ mantravarṇaṃ kṛtvā japanmanum | lakṣaṃ niyatavākśuddhaḥ siddhamantrastadā bhaveta||18|| vākśaktikamalāyuktaṃ japenmantraṃ susādhakaḥ | lakṣaṃ niśīthe śuddhātmā kṣīrabhojanamacarana| tadā siddho bhavenmantraḥ sarvakāmyaphalapradaḥ ||19|| atha puraścaraṇavidhiḥ atha vakṣye puraścaryāvidhiṃ mantrārthasiddhaye | yaṃ ṛte na bhavetsiddhirmantrāṇāṃ kimu karmaṇām ||20|| dhanairvāsoyugairdivyairalaṅkārairmanoramaiḥ | santoṣya śrīguruṃ premṇā vākyena sevayāpi ca ||21|| pādau karābhyāṃ saṃspṛśya praṇamya daṇḍavadbhuvi | kariṣye mantravaryasya puraścaraṇamuttamam ||22|| ājñāṃ me dehi bhagavansarvakāmyārthasiddhaye | evaṃ prasāditaḥ prītyā guruṇā sādhakottamaḥ ||23|| devagehe'śvatthamūle puṣpodyāne nadītaṭe | paravate svardhunītīre kṣetre śrīpuruṣottame ||24|| teṣāmekatame sthāne samāhitamanāḥ śuciḥ | āhārādivihārārthaṃ krośayugmaṃ samantataḥ ||25|| kṣīrivṛkṣodbhavaiḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ khānitairdikṣu kalpayeta| japasthānam, kūrmacakraṃ navakoṣṭhasamanvitam ||26|| aṣṭavargaṃ likhettatra kṣetrākhyādyākṣaraṃ yataḥ | tanmukhaṃ tadbhavettatra cailājinakuśottaram ||27|| āsanaṃ sthāpayenmanmantrairmantritaṃ tatra sādhakaḥ | svastikaṃ kamaladvāpi baddhāsanamananyadhīḥ ||28|| upaviśya ca pūrvedyurgāyatrīṃ prajapetsudhīḥ | saṅkalpatilakuśābhyāṃ prāyaścittavidhikramāta||29|| tataḥ prārambhadivase prātaḥ snātvāsanopari | upaviśya ca saṅkalpaṃ kṛtvā nyastatanuḥ śuciḥ ||30|| mantraṃ naiva drutaṃ naiva vilambitamananyadhīḥ | dhyāyanmantrākṣaraṃ devaṃ daśadhā saṃskṛtaṃ punaḥ ||31|| japetsūryodayātyāvanmadhyandinaṃ samāhitaḥ | yāvatsaṅkhyo japastatra divase tāvadanvaham ||32|| trikālapūjā kartavyā harirdravyaṃ nivedayeta| śeṣabhojī mitāhāro mitavākpriyabhāṣaṇaḥ ||33|| striyā sambhāṣaṇaṃ tyājyaṃ śūdrasambhāṣaṇaṃ tathā | manaḥ pralobhanaṃ kāryaṃ na ca nānā manorathaiḥ ||34|| evaṃ pūrṇajapo hutvā homāśaktau vidhānavita| daśāṃśaṃ homasaṅkhyānāṃ caturguṇamanuṃ japeta||35|| tarpaṇaṃ cābhiṣekaṃ ca kuryānmantrī vidhikramāta| brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā kṛtakāryo bhavetsukhī ||36|| evaṃ pramāṇamālambya kalau saṅkhyācaturguṇā | evaṃ caturguṇajapātsiddho mantro bhavennṛṇām ||37|| athopasaṃhāraḥ vairāgyeṇa vinā mantrasiddhirno jāyate nṛṇām | tasmātsarvaḥ prayatnena viraktaḥ prajapenmanum ||38|| vairāgyaṃ vāsanā śaunyamihāmutra ca daihike | kāmātkordhācca mohācca dambhāhaṅkārayogataḥ ||39|| mātsaryāllobhato jātā vāsanā duravagrahā | tayā saṃsaktamanasāṃ kāryasiddhirna jāyate ||40|| prīto devo varaṃ dātā sa ca prītaḥ kathaṃ bhaveta| durvāsanāṃ parityajya sadā sadvāsanāyutaḥ ||41|| kāyena manasā vācā svadharmaparamānasaḥ | yathāvidhikrameṇaiva japanmantraṃ susādhakaḥ ||42|| yadā kṛṣṇaṃ bhajedbhaktyā nityasandhyātraye sukhī | tannāmanirato'bhīkṣṇaṃ tatpādamananotsavaḥ ||43|| tatkathāśravaṇollāsī bhṛśaṃ tadrūpadarśakaḥ | evaṃ cennirapekṣo'pi sāpekṣo vā samāhitaḥ ||44|| gurvājñāmananāsakto gurudevātmako'niśam | tadā priyamanāḥ kṛṣṇo nirapekṣāya sādaram ||45|| nijapādāmbuje prītiṃ dadāti premalakṣaṇām | sāpekṣāya yathākāmyaṃ dadāti varamuttamam | nānyathā jāyate siddhiḥ koṭisaṅkhyajapādibhiḥ ||46|| vairāgyaṃ jāyate kena kṣiṇoti vāsanāṃ kutaḥ | yataḥ siddhimavāpnoti sarvakalyāṇasādhikām ||47|| sannadhā vaiṣṇave śāstre guruvākye ca sādhavaḥ | sādhusaṅgena śāstroktyā gurubhaktiḥ suniṣṭhitā ||48|| tanniṣṭhaśāstrasiddhānte pratītirjāyate nṛṇām | tadvākyena hi saṃjñānaṃ jāyate tena tattvataḥ ||49|| bhadrābhadraṃ vijānīte tyājyaṃ grāhyaṃ viśeṣataḥ | tyajettyāgakṛtābhyāso grāhyagrahaṇatatparaḥ ||50|| evaṃ saṃjāyate jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ tataḥ | tena jñānena saṃchinnā bhaveddurvāsanā bhṛśam ||51|| yathā buddhyā yajankṛṣṇamātaptakanakojjvalam | japenmantraṃ yathāsaṅkhaṃ mantradevaikavigraham ||52|| evaṃ siddhamanurmantrī kṛtakāryo yathāsukham | viharetparamaprītyā paramānandavigrahaḥ ||53|| iti bhakticandrikāyāmaṣṭaḥ paṭalaḥ
